title: 2020 International Consensus on Cardiopulmonary Resuscitation and Emergency Cardiovascular Care Science With Treatment Recommendations
publisher: International Liaison Committee on Resuscitation / Resuscitation
claims: ILCOR publishes the international evidence review that national councils, including the AHA and ERC, adapt into their guidelines.
The 2020 CoSTR BLS document covers recognition, emergency calling and bystander response.
It supports dispatch-assisted recognition and instruction as part of the emergency response system.
